text:
Tara (Design): Quick check on token create UI — thinking we should make visibility explicit to cut support tickets. Small change only.
Alex (PM): Short ask: fewer 'where did my token go' DMs. Keep create flow tight.
Bo (Eng): Current flow shows the token once in a drawer. If we add a 'Recorded' option we need vault + audit logs. Marking infra-impact.
Nina (A11y): If label says 'shown once' include it in the visible label and add aria-describedby to a tooltip that explains 'why recorded'. Use aria-live on reveal.
Tara (Design): Proposed micro: under name add 'Visibility: ( ) Ephemeral — shown once  ( ) Recorded — stored & auditable' default Ephemeral. Change CTA to 'Copy token (shown once)' and secondary 'Download .env (contains token)'.
Alex (PM): Rotation UX: add optional 'Grace period' toggle in rotate modal. Default off; if on, default 24h soft-revoke. Show clear risk note.
Bo (Eng): Can do. We'll emit separate audit events for soft vs hard revoke and add per-org config later.
Nina (A11y): Modal focus must land on confirm; Esc should announce closure. Tooltips and pills need keyboard focus and text labels (not color-only).
infra-bot: infra-bot: "Flagging epic-601: token-visibility -> requires KMS + audit-store review."
Alex (PM): Next steps: Tara posts two tiny mocks (inline vs modal), Bo returns estimate, Nina posts a11y checklist, I'll schedule security quick sync.
